The '''Mon Mothma Memorial Medical Center''' was a [[Medcenter/Legends|hospital]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] named after [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], hero of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==History==
[[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Valin Horn]] was taken there in [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]] after he suffered a [[Force psychosis|psychotic breakdown]]. Shortly after, however, he was transferred back to the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]], and eventually encased in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]] and placed in the [[Armand Isard Correctional Facility]].
